concurrency_finding.interpretation: Multiple dispatch-triggering commits and two distinct concurrency groups exist for the same semantic ASR008/F2 subject. This is control-plane churn risk. It does not prove that multiple target executions completed, but it is sufficient to forbid another dispatch until existing runs/queues are reconciled.

receipt_contract_fence.note: A real ASR execution may still be valuable raw evidence. Duplicate executions must not multiply confidence or credit, and a controller receipt that omits validator-required facts cannot be promoted by narrative adaptation.

next_exact_action: Resolve the actual GitHub Actions run/queue set for both ASR008 workflows. Preserve every terminal receipt/log by exact run id and controller commit. Select at most one semantically current valid execution subject for promotion analysis; treat extra equivalent runs as duplicate evidence only. Do not write either trigger path again until the singleton boundary is reconciled. If another run is later required, first collapse dispatch authority to one admitted workflow/concurrency/lease boundary and bind the exact current receipt contract.
